about: Planted doc errors for bench/run.mjs --mutants. Each mutant applies one find/replace (find must occur exactly once) to the live Grafana doc, which is then served from localhost. A run catches the mutant when it reports a 'doc says' mismatch or a failed step on a doc step containing one of the anchors. 'known' lists anchors of steps with real mismatches in Grafana 13.2.2, so findings there are not counted as false alarms.
